newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains unch to up after stg dominated day.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains unch to up after stg dominated day.

text.p: LIFFE grain futures ended unchanged to firmer after another day of trade dominated by sterling's moves against other European currencies.

The UK currency's early strength against the mark in particular sent futures down, with active May wheat hitting a low of 93.00 stg. But as sterling gave back its early rises, futures came back up, with May last traded up 0.25 stg at 93.75 stg.
May volume was 284 lots, out of a total of 588 on wheat.
The same pattern was to be seen in barley, with active March last traded 0.45 stg up at 92.25. Of a total 17 lots of barley traded, 12 were on March.

"Whichever way the currency moves, we do the opposite," one trader said. But he noted that currency related moves were getting muted. "At one time we reckoned on a 0.40 sterling move with each pfennig change in the exchange rate, but now it's not going that far," he said.
Sterling dropped near three pfennigs after setting a fresh 52-month peak of 2.7685 marks after comments from Germany's Bundesbank cooled speculation Germany favoured a higher dollar.
